source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The quadratic Taylor term converges to the diffusion Hessian contraction. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source.original_text:
Construct a Euclidean process from completed Itô rows. Suppose it stays in compact K almost surely throughout the horizon and the scalar test is twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at every point of K. The dyadic sum of half the Hessian applied twice to the actual increment converges in measure to the time integral of half the sum of the Hessian on the diffusion columns.

The positive horizon is T. The sample measure is finite, the filtration satisfies the usual conditions, and the driving standard vector Brownian motion is relative to that filtration and measure.
The finite coordinate rows have progressive product-square-integrable diffusion coefficients. Their drift evaluations at each fixed time t≤T are almost-everywhere strongly measurable.
Almost every drift path is continuous with bounded variation on [0,T].
The compact set K has a selected fallback point k₀. On one event of full measure, the process belongs to K at every time in [0,T]. The test is twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at each point of K.

\sum_i \tfrac12 D^2 f(X_{t_i})[\Delta_iX,\Delta_iX]\xrightarrow{\mu}\int_{[0,T]}\tfrac12\sum_j D^2f(X_s)[\sigma_j(s),\sigma_j(s)]\,ds.

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,
    u_2, u_3}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J]
  [DecidableEq J] {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : NNReal} {B : NNReal → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B
      filtration μ)
  (hT : 0 < T)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
  (η :
    I → J → AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T)
  (A : I → NNReal → Ω → ℝ) (hAmeas : ∀ (i : I), ∀ t ≤ T, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (A i t) μ)
  (hA :
    ∀ (i : I),
      ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧ BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T))
  {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)} (hK : IsCompact K) (fallback : ↑K) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ x ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
  have X := fun t ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 fun i =>
      A i t ω +
        ∑ j,
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ⋯
            hUsual t ω;
  have H := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f);
  have σ := fun j t ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => (η i j).process t ω;
  (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ t ≤ T, X t ω ∈ K) →
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ
      (fun n ω =>
        have t :=
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
            (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T n)
            (2 ^ n);
        ∑ i,
          have Δ := X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω;
          1 / 2 * ((H (X (t i.castSucc) ω)) Δ) Δ)
      Filter.atTop fun ω =>
      ∫ (s : NNReal),
        1 / 2 *
          ∑ j,
            ((H (X s ω)) (σ j s ω)) (σ j s ω) ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T

blind_reconstruction.text:
Finite state type I and Brownian type J; eta_ij; finite-variation coordinate processes A_i; resulting X; compact K and fallback∈K; scalar f. Hessian H=D(Df), diffusion columns sigma_j=(eta_ij)_i.

Omega is measurable with finite measure mu and a filtration F indexed by nonnegative reals. T>0 is fixed. The Euclidean coordinate type J is finite with decidable equality. B:[0,infinity)×Omega→R^J. lambda_T denotes the pullback under NNReal.toReal of Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. I is finite with decidable equality. A_i:[0,infinity)×Omega→R; X:[0,infinity)×Omega→R^I; f:R^I→R; K⊆R^I.

Assumptions: B starts at zero for every omega, has jointly independent increments over disjoint half-open intervals, every continuous real linear functional ell sends B_t-B_s (s<t) to a centered Gaussian of variance (t-s)||ell||², and paths are continuous mu-a.e. B is strongly adapted to F and B_t-B_s is independent of F_s for s≤t. F is right-continuous and every subset S⊆Omega with mu(S)=0 belongs to F_t for every t≥0. A progressive L² integrand is a real process a(t,omega), strongly progressive for F, for which (omega,t)↦a(t,omega) is in L²(mu⊗lambda_T). For every i and t≤T, A_i(t,·) is mu-a.e. strongly measurable. For every i, mu-a.e. omega, A_i(·,omega) is continuous and of bounded variation on [0,T]. K compact, fallback∈K; f is ambient C² at every point of K. On one mu-full set, X(t,omega)∈K for every t≤T. No progressivity of A_i is explicitly assumed.

Conclusion: I_j(a)(t,omega) denotes the specified completed Ito integral driven by the scalar coordinate B^j(t,omega)=(B(t,omega))_j. Its representative is the pointwise limit of chosen elementary stochastic integrals off the null complement of their uniform Cauchy event, and zero on that complement; it is held constant after T. Define X_i(t)=A_i(t)+∑_j I_j(eta_ij)(t), t_r^n=rT/2^n, Delta_r^n X=X(t_{r+1}^n)-X(t_r^n). With H=D(Df) and sigma_j(s)=(eta_ij(s))_i, the functions (1/2)∑_{r=0}^{2^n-1}H(X(t_r^n))[Delta_r^n X,Delta_r^n X] converge in mu-measure to ∫(1/2)∑_j H(X(s))[sigma_j(s),sigma_j(s)]d lambda_T(s).

Quantifier order: Universally quantify setup, A, compact K, fallback and f. Under the full-measure all-time range condition X(t,omega)∈K for t≤T, the stated dyadic sums converge in measure.

Scope: Fixed positive horizon; dyadic sequence n→infinity; convergence in measure only. A_i need not be given as a drift integral. Path and range hypotheses are almost sure and simultaneous in time, whereas A_i's marginal measurability is for each time.

Constant dependencies: No unspecified numerical constants or convergence rate; fallback is supplied but does not occur in the displayed limit.

/-- The actual quadratic Taylor terms of the completed vector Itô process
converge to the Hessian contraction against its diffusion columns. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_half_hessian_increments
    {Ω I J : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : ℝ≥0}
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration μ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
    (η : I → J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T) (A : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hAmeas : ∀ i t, t ≤ T → AEStronglyMeasurable (A i t) μ)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
      BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)} (hK : IsCompact K) (fallback : K) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    let X := fun (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => A i t ω + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω)
    let H := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)
    let σ := fun (j : J) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) =>
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => (η i j).process t ω)
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ t ≤ T, X t ω ∈ K) →
    TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
      let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n),
        let Δ := X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H (X (t i.castSucc) ω) Δ Δ) atTop
      (fun ω => ∫ s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : J, H (X s ω) (σ j s ω) (σ j s ω))
        ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) := by
  intro X H σ hRange
  let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  let e := EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ
  let W (q : I × I) (s : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H (X s ω) (e q.1) (e q.2)
  let Δ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) (ω : Ω) := X (t n i.succ) ω - X (t n i.castSucc) ω
  let b (q : I × I) (s : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ j : J, (η q.1 j).process s ω * (η q.2 j).process s ω
  let F (q : I × I) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), W q (t n i.castSucc) ω * (Δ n i ω q.1 * Δ n i ω q.2)
  let G (q : I × I) (ω : Ω) := ∫ s, W q s ω * b q s ω ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hH : ContinuousOn H K := fun x hx =>
    (((hf x hx).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by decide)).continuousAt_fderiv
      (by decide)).continuousWithinAt
  have hEntry (q : I × I) :
      ContinuousOn (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H x (e q.1) (e q.2)) K :=
    continuousOn_const.mul ((hH.clm_apply continuousOn_const).clm_apply continuousOn_const)
  obtain ⟨hXm, hXc⟩ := measurable_continuousOn_euclidean_ito_rows
    hB hT hUsual η A hAmeas (fun i => (hA i).mono fun _ h => h.1)
  have hWm (q : I × I) (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (W q s) μ := by
    have hY := (measurable_restrictState hK.isClosed.measurableSet fallback).comp (hXm s hs)
    refine ((hEntry q).domRestrict.measurable.comp hY).aestronglyMeasurable.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
    change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H (restrictState fallback (X s ω) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)
      (e q.1) (e q.2) = W q s ω
    rw [coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr s hs)]
  have hWc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ q : I × I, ContinuousOn (fun s => W q s ω) (Icc 0 T) := by
    filter_upwards [hXc, hRange] with ω hω hr q
    exact (hEntry q).comp hω (fun s hs => hr s hs.2)
  have hLim (q : I × I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F q) atTop (G q) :=
    tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_weighted_covariation_of_ito_rows hB hT hUsual
      (η q.1) (η q.2) (A q.1) (A q.2) (W q) (hAmeas q.1) (hAmeas q.2)
      (hWm q) (hA q.1) (hA q.2) (hWc.mono fun _ h => h q)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  have hFm (q : I × I) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (F q n) μ := by
    have hΔm (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) (j : I) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Δ n i ω j) μ :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.measurable.comp
        ((hXm _ (ht n i.succ)).sub (hXm _ (ht n i.castSucc)))).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hCell (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => W q (t n i.castSucc) ω *
          (Δ n i ω q.1 * Δ n i ω q.2)) μ :=
      (hWm q _ (ht n i.castSucc)).mul ((hΔm i q.1).mul (hΔm i q.2))
    exact (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hCell i).congr
      (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp only [F, Finset.sum_apply])
  have hHalf (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H x v v = ∑ q : I × I,
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * H x (e q.1) (e q.2)) * (v q.1 * v q.2) := by
    rw [euclidean_bilinear_eq_sum_basis (H x) v v, Finset.mul_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  have hSum := tendstoInMeasure_fintype_sum hFm hLim
  refine TendstoInMeasure.congr ?_ ?_ hSum
  · intro n
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      change (∑ q : I × I, ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n),
        W q (t n i.castSucc) ω * (Δ n i ω q.1 * Δ n i ω q.2)) =
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H (X (t n i.castSucc) ω) (Δ n i ω) (Δ n i ω)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact (hHalf _ _).symm
  · have hProduct : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ q : I × I, ∀ j : J,
        Integrable (fun s => (η q.1 j).process s ω * (η q.2 j).process s ω)
          (TimeMeasure.upTo T) :=
      ae_all_iff.2 fun q => ae_all_iff.2 fun j =>
        ((η q.1 j).memLp.integrable_mul (η q.2 j).memLp).prod_right_ae
    filter_upwards [hProduct, hWc] with ω hp hw
    let ν := TimeMeasure.upTo T
    have hMem : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T :=
      (TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T).mono fun _ hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
    have hRest : ν.restrict (Icc 0 T) = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hMem
    have hInt (q : I × I) : Integrable (fun s => W q s ω * b q s ω) ν := by
      have hDensity : Integrable (fun s => b q s ω) ν := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hp q j)
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.bddAbove_image (hw q).norm
      have hMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => W q s ω) ν := by
        rw [← hRest]
        exact (hw q).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
      exact hDensity.bdd_mul hMeas (hMem.mono fun s hs => hC ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
    change (∑ q : I × I, ∫ s, W q s ω * b q s ω ∂ν) =
      ∫ s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : J, H (X s ω) (σ j s ω) (σ j s ω)) ∂ν
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun q _ => hInt q)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      simp only [b, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact (hHalf _ (σ j s ω)).symm

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicHessian

notation.text: The process rows use the actual completed integrals. The jth diffusion column has ith coordinate ηᵢⱼ.

steps.title: Use each Hessian entry as a weight
steps.text: The Hessian is continuous on K, so the weight path is continuous on the common event. Compose each measurable slice with the measurable fallback into K, then with the continuous restricted Hessian entry. This representative equals the actual Hessian entry almost everywhere, so the actual weight slice is almost everywhere strongly measurable.

steps.text: Apply continuous-weight covariation to the corresponding completed rows, and sum over the finite set of ordered coordinate pairs.

have hLim (q : I × I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F q) atTop (G q) :=

      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  have hFm (q : I × I) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (F q n) μ := by
    have hΔm (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) (j : I) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Δ n i ω j) μ :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.measurable.comp

    have hCell (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :

    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

      intro i _
      exact (hHalf _ _).symm
  · have hProduct : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ q : I × I, ∀ j : J,
        Integrable (fun s => (η q.1 j).process s ω * (η q.2 j).process s ω)
          (TimeMeasure.upTo T) :=
      ae_all_iff.2 fun q => ae_all_iff.2 fun j =>
        ((η q.1 j).memLp.integrable_mul (η q.2 j).memLp).prod_right_ae
    filter_upwards [hProduct, hWc] with ω hp hw
    let ν := TimeMeasure.upTo T
    have hMem : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T :=
      (TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T).mono fun _ hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
    have hRest : ν.restrict (Icc 0 T) = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hMem
    have hInt (q : I × I) : Integrable (fun s => W q s ω * b q s ω) ν := by
      have hDensity : Integrable (fun s => b q s ω) ν := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hp q j)
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.bddAbove_image (hw q).norm
      have hMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => W q s ω) ν := by
        rw [← hRest]
        exact (hw q).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
      exact hDensity.bdd_mul hMeas (hMem.mono fun s hs => hC ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
    change (∑ q : I × I, ∫ s, W q s ω * b q s ω ∂ν) =
      ∫ s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : J, H (X s ω) (σ j s ω) (σ j s ω)) ∂ν
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun q _ => hInt q)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      simp only [b, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact (hHalf _ (σ j s ω)).symm

lesson.lean_statement: The Hessian is the derivative of the Fréchet derivative, evaluated on the actual vector increments and diffusion columns.
lesson.lean_proof: Use coordinate weighted covariation and exact finite summation, with the pathwise integral justified by product L² and continuity.
